headline: Clinton order blocks property of UNITA, an Angolan rebel group, and bans certain dealings with it.
what_it_does: This executive order freezes property and assets of UNITA that fall under US control. It also bans certain business and financial dealings with UNITA. The title does not list which exact dealings are banned, so the full details are not known from this source alone.

who_it_affects.group: UNITA (an armed political group in Angola) and its members
who_it_affects.how: Their property under US control is frozen and cannot be used, moved, or sold.
They are barred from certain transactions with UNITA.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed August 18, 1998; the exact start date is not stated in the source provided.
